about: Route selection cases shared by backend/services/node_route.py select_route and frontend/src/lib/directRoute.ts selectRoute, against the real node catalog. paramKeys (when given) are the params that route shows and sends, sorted. Each case runs on its 'today' (YYYY-MM-DD), else on defaultToday, so date-gated routes (node_route.DIRECT_RETIRES) don't flip when the calendar does.
